Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, join compound_records on molregno, join activities on record_id, join assays on assay_id, join docs on doc_id, join target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target_chembl_id CHEMBL222, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, canonical_smiles is not null, and pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
